name: Chicken & rice bowl
notes: Sliced grilled chicken fanned over a bed of fluffy white rice, finished with charred vegetables and a drizzle of pan jus — a clean weeknight bowl that satisfies without weighing you down.

name: Chicken stir-fry
notes: Strips of chicken seared in a screaming-hot wok with bell peppers, broccoli, and onion, glossed in a savory soy-garlic sauce and tipped over steamed rice.

name: Salmon plate
notes: A blushing fillet of salmon, skin crackling-crisp, plated beside roasted potatoes and a tangle of bright greens — restaurant comfort, weeknight-easy.

name: Sashimi platter
notes: Glassy slices of raw tuna, salmon, and yellowtail fanned across a chilled board with pickled ginger, a green daub of wasabi, and a side of soy.

name: Tuna salad
notes: Flaked tuna folded into a lemon-bright dressing with celery and red onion, mounded over crisp greens — a brown-bag classic done well.

name: Fish and chips
notes: Golden-battered white fish that shatters at first bite, paired with thick salt-flecked chips, a scoop of mushy peas, and a wedge of lemon.

name: Shrimp pasta
notes: Pink shrimp tossed in butter, garlic, and white wine, draped over al dente pasta with a snow of parmesan and fresh parsley.

name: Burger
notes: A char-edged beef patty stacked with lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles between a soft toasted bun — the original handheld comfort.

name: Cheeseburger
notes: A juicy beef patty crowned with a melting slice of American cheese, layered with crisp lettuce, tomato, and pickles in a buttery toasted bun.

name: Steak dinner
notes: A rested ribeye sliced against the grain, plated with buttery mashed potatoes and a stem of charred green vegetable — the steakhouse blueprint.

name: Bacon and eggs
notes: Eggs cooked sunny-side up, yolks ready to break across the plate, served with crisp bacon and buttered toast.

name: Vegetable & cheese omelet
notes: A pale-gold three-egg omelet folded around a melting heap of sautéed peppers, mushrooms, and shredded cheese.

name: Yogurt parfait
notes: Tangy Greek yogurt layered with fresh berries, a drizzle of honey, and toasted granola for crunch — served in a tall glass.

name: Berry smoothie
notes: Frozen berries blended with yogurt and a splash of milk into a thick purple pour, optionally sweetened with honey.

name: Cereal bowl
notes: A cold bowl of crisp flakes and milk with sliced banana on top — the unglamorous classic that just works.

name: Oatmeal with berries
notes: Creamy steel-cut oats topped with juicy berries, a scatter of nuts, and a swirl of milk and brown sugar.

name: Cheese plate
notes: An assortment of sliced and cubed cheeses on a wooden board with dried fruit, honey, and a fan of crackers.

name: Greek salad
notes: Crisp cucumber, ripe tomato, red onion, and briny olives tossed in olive oil and oregano, crowned with a thick slab of feta.

name: Caesar salad
notes: Crunchy romaine tossed in a garlicky anchovy-laced dressing, finished with parmesan shards and golden croutons.

name: Hummus plate
notes: A pool of silky, lemon-bright hummus dimpled with olive oil, served with warm pita triangles and a scatter of crudités.

name: Bean burrito
notes: Refried beans, melted cheese, and a spoon of salsa wrapped tight in a soft warm flour tortilla, griddled until lightly toasted.

name: Vegan grain bowl
notes: A composed bowl of warm grains, roasted vegetables, beans, and a tahini drizzle — plant-only and deeply satisfying.

name: Tofu stir-fry
notes: Cubes of golden-seared tofu tossed with crisp vegetables in a glossy ginger-soy sauce, served over steamed rice.

name: Peanut butter sandwich
notes: Creamy peanut butter and a thin slick of jam between two slices of soft bread — the lunchbox staple.

name: Pasta with red sauce
notes: Al dente pasta tossed in a long-simmered tomato sauce, finished with torn basil and a generous shower of parmesan.

name: Fruit & nuts
notes: A small handful of fresh sliced fruit beside a scatter of roasted, salted nuts — a snack that feels grown-up.

name: Pancakes & syrup
notes: A stack of buttermilk pancakes, edges lacy and golden, crowned with a melting pat of butter and a slow pour of maple syrup.

name: Mac and cheese
notes: Tender macaroni in a silky cheddar-cream sauce, baked under a crackling breadcrumb crust — the ultimate comfort.

name: Cobb salad
notes: Composed rows of grilled chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, hard-boiled egg, and blue cheese over chopped romaine — a salad that eats like a meal.

name: BBQ plate
notes: Smoky pulled pork or sliced brisket lacquered with sauce, served with creamy coleslaw, cornbread, and a soft bun.

name: Thanksgiving plate
notes: A slice of roast turkey blanketed in gravy, beside mashed potatoes, sage stuffing, candied yams, green beans, and a spoon of cranberry sauce.

name: Biscuits and gravy
notes: Flaky buttermilk biscuits split open and smothered in peppery sausage gravy — a Southern Sunday plate.

name: Chicken and waffles
notes: Crisp buttermilk-fried chicken perched on golden waffles, syrup pooling at the edges and a knob of butter melting on top.

name: Club sandwich
notes: A triple-decker tower of toasted bread layered with turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and mayo, skewered into four neat triangles.

name: Reuben sandwich
notes: Corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Russian dressing griddled between slices of rye until the cheese is melting and the bread is buttery-crisp.

name: Buffalo wings
notes: Crackling fried chicken wings tumbled in a glossy butter-hot-sauce, served with celery sticks and a cup of cool blue cheese dressing.

name: Chili con carne
notes: A slow-simmered bowl of ground beef, beans, tomato, and chiles — thick, smoky, and topped with cheese, sour cream, and scallions.

name: Philly cheesesteak
notes: Thin shaved beef and sweated onions piled into a soft hoagie roll, draped with melted provolone or Cheez Whiz.

name: Meatloaf with mashed potato
notes: A thick slab of glazed meatloaf beside a soft mound of mashed potatoes pooling with gravy — diner comfort.

name: Lobster roll
notes: Cool lobster meat barely bound with mayo (or warmed in butter), tucked into a buttery, griddled split-top bun.

name: Full English breakfast
notes: Eggs, bacon, sausages, baked beans, grilled tomato, mushrooms, and a slice of toast — the full plate, all at once.

name: Shepherd's pie
notes: Spiced minced lamb and peas beneath a crown of mashed potato, baked until the top peaks are crisp and golden.

name: Bangers and mash
notes: Plump pork sausages over creamy mashed potatoes, smothered with rich onion gravy — pub comfort.

name: Ploughman's lunch
notes: A casual lunch board of cheese, cold ham, pickles, crusty bread, butter, and a tart apple.

name: Sunday roast
notes: Sliced roast beef with crisp Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, root vegetables, and a glossy ladle of gravy.

name: Scones with cream and jam
notes: Warm crumbly scones split and piled high with thick clotted cream and strawberry jam, alongside a pot of tea.

name: Beef Wellington
notes: A rosy beef tenderloin wrapped in mushroom duxelles and golden puff pastry, sliced to reveal blush-pink centers.

name: Toad in the hole
notes: Plump pork sausages baked into a billowing golden Yorkshire pudding, served with onion gravy.

name: Croque-monsieur
notes: Ham and Gruyère sandwiched in buttered bread, the top blanketed in béchamel and broiled until bubbling and bronzed.

name: Ratatouille
notes: Slow-stewed eggplant, zucchini, peppers, onion, and tomato in olive oil and herbs — silky, savory, deeply Provençal.

name: Beef bourguignon
notes: Chunks of beef braised slowly in red wine with mushrooms, pearl onions, and bacon until forktender and gravy-rich.

name: Salade niçoise
notes: Composed wedges of seared tuna, green beans, olives, hard-boiled egg, and small potatoes over greens with a sharp vinaigrette.

name: French omelette
notes: A pale, just-set omelette rolled into a slim cylinder, the inside still loose — buttery, custardy, deceptively simple.

name: Coq au vin
notes: Chicken simmered low and slow in red wine with mushrooms, lardons, and pearl onions until the sauce turns silky.

name: Bouillabaisse
notes: A saffron-stained Provençal seafood stew of fish and shellfish, served with crusty bread and a smear of garlicky rouille.

name: Quiche Lorraine
notes: A blind-baked tart shell holding a custard of cream and eggs, studded with smoky lardons — set just enough to slice clean.

name: Cassoulet
notes: A bubbling earthenware crock of white beans slow-cooked with duck confit, sausage, and pork, capped with a crisp golden crust.

name: Savory crêpes
notes: Paper-thin buckwheat crêpes folded around ham, Gruyère, and a runny egg, edges crisp and lacy.

name: Caprese salad
notes: Alternating slices of milky mozzarella and ripe tomato, finished with torn basil, flaky salt, and a slick of olive oil.

name: Pasta carbonara
notes: Hot spaghetti tossed with crisp guanciale, sharp pecorino, and egg yolks into a glossy, peppery sauce — no cream, just emulsion.

name: Pasta bolognese
notes: Tagliatelle coiled in a long-simmered meat ragù — rich, savory, finished with parmesan and a drag of butter.

name: Pesto pasta
notes: Trofie or trenette dressed with a vivid green basil-pine-nut-parmesan pesto, tossed with cubed potato and green beans Ligurian-style.

name: Pasta all'amatriciana
notes: Bucatini in a spicy tomato sauce rich with crisp guanciale and pecorino — Roman, fiery, and unapologetic.

name: Mushroom risotto
notes: Creamy short-grain rice stirred patiently with wine and stock until al dente, folded with seared wild mushrooms and parmesan.

name: Risotto Milanese
notes: Saffron-stained risotto, golden and glossy, finished with butter, parmesan, and a hint of beef marrow.

name: Pizza margherita
notes: A blistered-edge Neapolitan crust topped with crushed tomato, torn fior di latte, basil leaves, and a slick of olive oil.

name: Osso buco
notes: Cross-cut veal shanks braised until the meat falls off the bone, the marrow scooped onto crusty bread and finished with gremolata.

name: Lasagna
notes: Layers of pasta sheets, slow-cooked meat ragù, béchamel, and parmesan, baked until the top is bubbling and burnished.

name: Paella
notes: Saffron-tinted short-grain rice cooked wide in a shallow pan with chicken, chorizo, shellfish, and peas — the crust on the bottom (socarrat) is the prize.

name: Tortilla española
notes: A thick wedge of egg-and-potato omelette set with sweet onion, served warm or room-temperature, sturdy enough to slice and pass around.

name: Gazpacho
notes: A chilled raw-tomato soup blended with cucumber, pepper, garlic, and olive oil — bright, savory, and meant for hot afternoons.

name: Patatas bravas
notes: Crisp-edged fried potato cubes drizzled with a smoky brava sauce and a swirl of garlic aioli — a tapas mainstay.

name: Bacalhau com natas
notes: Flakes of salt cod layered with onions and thin potato slices in cream, baked until the top is bubbling and golden.

name: Wiener schnitzel
notes: A pounded-thin veal cutlet breaded and pan-fried to a crackling golden coat, served with lemon wedges and a side of potato salad.

name: Rösti
notes: Coarsely grated potato pressed into a crisp golden pancake, served alongside eggs, sausage, or smoked salmon.

name: Sauerbraten
notes: Marinated pot-roast beef slowly braised, then served sliced with a tangy gingerbread-thickened gravy and red cabbage.

name: Raclette platter
notes: Half-wheel cheese melted by the fire, scraped onto small potatoes, cornichons, and slices of cured ham.

name: Muesli bowl
notes: Rolled oats soaked in milk or yogurt with grated apple, dried fruit, and toasted nuts — Swiss bircher-style.

name: Käsespätzle
notes: Soft, irregular egg-noodle dumplings layered with melted Emmental and crisped onions — Germany's answer to mac and cheese.

name: Currywurst
notes: Sliced grilled bratwurst doused in a tangy curry-spiced tomato sauce, dusted with curry powder, served with fries or a roll.

name: Pierogi (potato-cheese)
notes: Half-moon dumplings stuffed with potato and farmer's cheese, boiled then pan-fried until edges crisp, served with sour cream and onions.

name: Borscht
notes: A magenta beet soup, faintly sour and sweet, served hot with a dollop of sour cream and a sprig of dill.

name: Goulash
notes: A paprika-stained Hungarian stew of beef and onions simmered slowly until the meat surrenders, served with bread or buttered noodles.

name: Blini with caviar
notes: Small warm yeasted pancakes topped with a dab of crème fraîche and a glistening spoon of caviar.

name: Stuffed cabbage rolls
notes: Tender cabbage leaves rolled around a savory pork-and-rice filling, simmered in a sweet-sour tomato sauce.

name: Smörgåsbord plate
notes: A composed plate of pickled herring, cured salmon, hard cheese, rye crackers, boiled eggs, and dill new potatoes.

name: Gravlax plate
notes: Translucent slices of dill-and-sugar-cured salmon over rye crisps with a mustard-dill sauce and shaved red onion.

name: Swedish meatballs
notes: Small tender pork-and-beef meatballs blanketed in a silky cream gravy, served with lingonberry jam and mashed potatoes.

name: Pickled herring plate
notes: Cool, bright pickled herring with red onion and dill, fanned beside boiled potatoes and a slice of dark rye.

name: Danish pastry & coffee
notes: A flaky butter-laminated pastry — twisted, sticky, glazed — alongside a hot mug of strong coffee.

name: Moussaka
notes: Layers of fried eggplant, spiced lamb, and tomato beneath a thick blanket of béchamel, baked until the top is bronzed and bubbling.

name: Spanakopita
notes: A golden parcel of phyllo wrapped around a savory spinach-and-feta filling — shatteringly crisp on the outside, herby and soft within.

name: Souvlaki plate
notes: Charred lemon-oregano pork skewers with warm pita, a scoop of tzatziki, and a tumble of Greek salad.

name: Kung pao chicken
notes: Diced chicken wok-fried with peanuts, dried red chiles, and Sichuan peppercorns in a glossy sweet-tart sauce.

name: Sweet-and-sour pork
notes: Crisp battered pork cubes glazed in a glossy red sauce with pineapple, green pepper, and onion.

name: Mapo tofu
notes: Soft cubes of tofu in a fierce red-oil sauce of fermented bean paste and Sichuan pepper, threaded with crumbled pork.

name: Dim sum platter
notes: An array of steamer baskets: pleated dumplings, fluffy pork buns, translucent shrimp har gow, and a small lake of soy.

name: Jiaozi (pork & cabbage)
notes: Half-moon pork-and-cabbage dumplings, boiled or pan-fried with a crisp bottom, served with a black vinegar dip.

name: Xiao long bao
notes: Delicate Shanghai soup dumplings pleated at the top — pierce, sip the hot broth, then bite the pork filling.

name: Wonton soup
notes: Slippery pork-and-shrimp wontons floating in a clear ginger-scallion broth — clean, light, and warming.

name: Congee
notes: Long-simmered rice porridge — silky, savory, ladled into bowls with shredded chicken, scallions, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Peking duck
notes: Crackling lacquered duck skin, fanned slices of breast, and steamed pancakes for rolling with scallion, cucumber, and hoisin.

name: Lion's head meatballs
notes: Oversized tender pork meatballs braised slowly in a savory broth with a nest of napa cabbage.

name: Yu-xiang eggplant
notes: Tender braised eggplant in a fish-fragrant sauce — sweet, sour, garlicky, and threaded with minced pork.

name: Twice-cooked pork
notes: Slices of pork belly first simmered, then stir-fried with leeks and chiles in a smoky fermented-bean sauce.

name: Dan dan noodles
notes: Springy noodles in a chili-oil-and-sesame sauce topped with crispy minced pork and pickled mustard greens — toss to combine.

name: Egg fried rice
notes: Day-old rice flashed in a hot wok with scrambled egg, soy, scallion, and a hit of sesame oil — quick, comforting, satisfying.

name: Char siu pork over rice
notes: Glossy lacquered slices of barbecued pork fanned over steamed white rice with bok choy and a drizzle of pan juices.

name: Sichuan hot pot
notes: A bubbling fiery red broth at the center of the table for cooking thin-sliced meat, tofu, mushrooms, and noodles to order.

name: Salt-and-pepper shrimp
notes: Whole shell-on shrimp wok-tossed with chiles, garlic, and a Sichuan-pepper-and-salt mix — fragrant, crackling, eat-the-shells.

name: Sushi nigiri platter
notes: Hand-pressed mounds of seasoned rice topped with glistening slices of tuna, salmon, shrimp, and mackerel, with a dab of wasabi.

name: Ramen (tonkotsu)
notes: A cloudy pork-bone broth simmered for hours, with springy noodles, chashu pork, ajitama egg, scallion, and bamboo shoots.

name: Ramen (shoyu)
notes: A clear soy-tinted broth over wavy noodles, topped with chashu pork, marinated egg, nori, and a sprinkle of scallion.

name: Ramen (miso)
notes: A nutty-rich miso-laced broth over thick chewy noodles, finished with sweet corn, butter, ground pork, and bean sprouts.

name: Gyudon (beef bowl)
notes: Thin-sliced beef simmered in a sweet-savory soy-mirin sauce with onion, ladled over hot rice with a soft pickled egg.

name: Oyakodon
notes: Chicken and softly set egg simmered together in a sweet dashi-soy broth, blanketed over steamed rice — "parent-and-child" bowl.

name: Katsudon
notes: A breaded pork cutlet, fried crisp then simmered with onion and egg in a sweet-savory broth, served over rice.

name: Tempura platter
notes: Shrimp and seasonal vegetables in a lacy, ice-cold batter, flash-fried until weightlessly crisp, served with a tentsuyu dipping sauce.

name: Okonomiyaki
notes: A savory cabbage pancake stuffed with pork, drizzled with Kewpie mayo and a sweet-sour brown sauce, finished with dancing bonito flakes.

name: Soba noodles
notes: Cool buckwheat noodles served on a bamboo mat with a chilled dipping sauce, scallions, and a touch of wasabi.

name: Udon noodles
notes: Thick chewy noodles in a clear dashi broth, topped with tempura, scallion, and a swirl of soy.

name: Tonkatsu plate
notes: A panko-crusted pork cutlet fried to a crackling gold, sliced and served with shredded cabbage, rice, and a tangy brown sauce.

name: Sukiyaki
notes: Thin-sliced beef and tofu simmered tableside with vegetables in a sweet soy-mirin broth, dipped into a raw beaten egg.

name: Shabu-shabu
notes: Paper-thin beef swished through a clear hot broth at the table, dipped into sesame or ponzu sauce with rice on the side.

name: Bibimbap
notes: A stone bowl of warm rice topped with neat piles of seasoned vegetables, beef, and a runny egg — stirred together with gochujang.

name: Bulgogi plate
notes: Marinated thin slices of beef grilled fast and hot, served with rice, lettuce wraps, and an array of small banchan dishes.

name: Kimbap
notes: Seasoned rice and a colorful line of fillings — egg, spinach, carrot, beef or imitation crab — rolled in nori and sliced into rounds.

name: Kimchi jjigae
notes: A bubbling red stew of aged kimchi, pork belly, tofu, and scallion — sour, spicy, and deeply comforting.

name: Sundubu jjigae
notes: A volcanic-red bowl of silken tofu, seafood, and chili oil cracked with a raw egg at the table, served with rice.

name: Korean BBQ platter
notes: Marinated short ribs, pork belly, and chicken grilled at the table, wrapped in lettuce leaves with rice, ssamjang, and pickles.

name: Japchae
notes: Glassy sweet potato noodles tossed with sesame oil, soy, beef, and a rainbow of julienned vegetables.

name: Samgyetang
notes: A whole young chicken stuffed with sweet rice, ginseng, and jujubes, simmered in a milky broth — a restorative Korean classic.

name: Tteokbokki
notes: Chewy cylindrical rice cakes simmered in a fiery sweet-spicy gochujang sauce with fish cake and scallion.

name: Pad thai
notes: Stir-fried rice noodles in a sweet-sour tamarind sauce with shrimp, egg, bean sprouts, lime, and a scatter of crushed peanuts.

name: Tom yum goong
notes: A clear, fragrant, sour-spicy broth of lemongrass, kaffir lime, and chili swimming with plump shrimp and mushrooms.

name: Green curry chicken
notes: Tender chicken simmered in a fragrant green coconut curry of basil, lime leaf, eggplant, and bird's eye chili.

name: Red curry chicken
notes: Chicken in a velvety red coconut curry of bamboo shoot, basil, and lime — sweet, hot, and creamy.

name: Massaman curry
notes: Slow-cooked beef and potato in a mellow, peanut-laced southern Thai curry — warming with cardamom and cinnamon.

name: Som tam (green papaya salad)
notes: Shredded green papaya pounded in a mortar with chiles, lime, fish sauce, palm sugar, peanuts, and tomato — crunchy, sour, fiery.

name: Larb
notes: Minced chicken or pork tossed warm with toasted rice powder, mint, lime, fish sauce, and red chili — eaten in lettuce cups.

name: Khao soi
notes: Egg noodles in a coconut-curry broth with braised chicken, topped with crispy fried noodles, pickled mustard greens, and shallot.

name: Pad see ew
notes: Wide rice noodles charred in the wok with Chinese broccoli, egg, and a sweet dark soy — smoky, savory, sturdy.

name: Pho bo
notes: Translucent rice noodles in a clear cinnamon-and-star-anise beef broth with rare slices of beef, basil, lime, and bean sprouts on the side.

name: Pho ga
notes: A clean chicken broth over rice noodles with poached chicken, scallion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime — Vietnamese soothing.

name: Bánh mì
notes: A crisp baguette stuffed with pork, pâté, pickled daikon and carrot, cilantro, jalapeño, and a slick of mayo — crunch, brightness, heat.

name: Bun bo Hue
notes: A bold spicy lemongrass beef-and-pork broth over thick round rice noodles, topped with herbs, lime, and chili paste.

name: Summer rolls
notes: Translucent rice-paper rolls wrapped around shrimp, vermicelli, lettuce, and mint, served with a peanut-hoisin dipping sauce.

name: Bún chả
notes: Charred pork patties and grilled pork belly in a sweet-sour fish sauce broth, served with rice noodles and a basket of herbs.

name: Cơm tấm
notes: Broken rice topped with a grilled lemongrass pork chop, a shredded pork-skin mix, a fried egg, and pickled vegetables.

name: Nasi goreng
notes: Indonesian fried rice with kecap manis and shrimp paste, topped with a fried egg, fried shallots, and a few prawn crackers.

name: Beef rendang
notes: Beef simmered for hours in coconut milk and spice paste until the liquid disappears and the meat is darkly fragrant and tender.

name: Laksa
notes: A coconut-and-chili-rich noodle soup with shrimp, tofu puffs, bean sprouts, and a swirl of sambal — Southeast Asian comfort.

name: Satay plate
notes: Skewers of grilled marinated chicken or beef glistening with peanut sauce, served with cucumber, rice cake, and a lime wedge.

name: Gado-gado
notes: Steamed and blanched vegetables, tofu, tempeh, and hard-boiled egg dressed with a rich peanut sauce — Indonesia's composed salad.

name: Mee goreng
notes: Yellow wheat noodles wok-fried with shrimp, egg, tofu, and chili-tomato seasoning — sweet, spicy, and tangy.

name: Chicken adobo
notes: Chicken braised in soy, vinegar, garlic, and bay until the sauce reduces to a glossy savory glaze — the Filipino home classic.

name: Sinigang
notes: A sour tamarind-laced broth bobbing with pork ribs, water spinach, daikon, and tomato — bracing and deeply comforting.

name: Lumpia
notes: Slim spring rolls of pork and vegetables fried golden and shattering-crisp, served with a sweet-and-sour dip.

name: Kare-kare
notes: Oxtail and tripe stewed in a thick peanut-and-annatto sauce with eggplant and bok choy, served with shrimp paste on the side.

name: Pancit
notes: Stir-fried rice noodles tossed with chicken, shrimp, and vegetables in a savory soy sauce — a Filipino birthday staple.

name: Butter chicken
notes: Tender tandoor-cooked chicken simmered in a velvety tomato-cream sauce sweetened with fenugreek and butter, eaten with naan.

name: Chicken tikka masala
notes: Charred yogurt-marinated chicken bobbing in a richly spiced tomato-cream sauce — the Anglo-Indian crowd-pleaser.

name: Pork vindaloo
notes: Pork braised in a fiery vinegar-and-chile masala — Goan, hot, tangy, and deep.

name: Chicken korma
notes: Chicken simmered gently in a mild, fragrant cream-and-cashew sauce flecked with cardamom and saffron.

name: Rogan josh
notes: Slow-cooked lamb in a Kashmiri sauce blushing red with chili and aromatic with fennel and ginger.

name: Chicken biryani
notes: Long-grain basmati layered with saffron-marinated chicken and fried onions, steamed until perfumed with cardamom and clove.

name: Paneer tikka
notes: Cubes of fresh cheese marinated in spiced yogurt, threaded on skewers with peppers and onion, and charred in a tandoor.

name: Palak paneer
notes: Cubes of soft paneer simmered in a vivid spinach purée seasoned with garlic, ginger, and fenugreek — eaten with warm roti.

name: Dal makhani
notes: Black lentils and kidney beans slow-cooked with cream and butter until impossibly silky, finished with a smoky tempering.

name: Dal tadka
notes: Yellow split lentils simmered until soft, finished with a sizzling tadka of ghee, cumin, mustard seed, and dried chili.

name: Masala dosa
notes: A paper-thin, lacy fermented-rice crêpe wrapped around a spiced potato filling, served with coconut chutney and sambar.

name: Idli sambar
notes: Pillowy steamed rice-and-lentil cakes served with a fragrant lentil-vegetable stew and coconut chutney for dipping.

name: Vegetarian thali
notes: A round metal platter holding small bowls of curries, dal, rice, raita, and pickles — a tour of flavors at one meal.

name: Samosa chaat
notes: Crispy samosas crumbled into a bowl, drowned in chickpea curry, tangy tamarind, mint chutney, yogurt, and crunchy sev.

name: Chana masala
notes: Chickpeas simmered in a robust tomato-onion-spice gravy brightened by amchur and ginger — eaten with bhatura or rice.

name: Aloo gobi
notes: Potato and cauliflower tossed dry-style with turmeric, cumin, and ginger until tender and just crisp at the edges.

name: Tandoori chicken
notes: Yogurt-and-spice marinated chicken charred in a tandoor until smoky and stained red, served with onion rings and lemon.

name: Rajma
notes: Red kidney beans simmered slowly in a tomato-onion masala — Punjabi home comfort, ladled over plain rice.

name: Nihari
notes: A slow-cooked beef shank stew finished with ginger, lemon, and fried shallots — eaten at dawn with naan.

name: Haleem
notes: A long-cooked porridge of wheat, lentils, and shredded meat seasoned with garam masala — thick, savory, and rib-sticking.

name: Pakistani mutton biryani
notes: Layered mutton biryani heavy with garam masala, fried onions, and saffron — fragrant, fiery, and meant for sharing.

name: Bengali fish curry
notes: Fish steaks simmered in a mustard-oil-and-poppy-seed gravy bright with green chili and turmeric — eaten with steamed rice.

name: Chapli kebab
notes: Flat spiced minced-beef patties studded with pomegranate seeds and green chili, shallow-fried until edges crisp.

name: Sri Lankan rice & curry
notes: A mound of rice surrounded by small servings of fiery, fragrant curries — fish, dal, coconut sambol, and more.

name: Hoppers (appa)
notes: Bowl-shaped fermented rice-and-coconut pancakes with crisp edges and a soft center, often with an egg cracked into the middle.

name: Kottu roti
notes: Shredded roti stir-fried on a hot griddle with vegetables, egg, and curry — chopped with a rhythmic clang, served piping hot.

name: Mezze plate
notes: A spread of small dishes — hummus, baba ganoush, tabbouleh, olives, pickles, and warm pita — meant for grazing.

name: Baba ganoush
notes: Smoky roasted eggplant whipped with tahini, lemon, and garlic — silky, char-tinged, scooped with warm pita.

name: Tabbouleh
notes: A bright bulgur salad heavy with chopped parsley and mint, tossed with tomato, lemon, and olive oil.

name: Fattoush
notes: A crunchy salad of cucumber, tomato, radish, and herbs tossed with toasted pita shards and a sumac-tart dressing.

name: Kibbeh
notes: Footballs of bulgur shell stuffed with spiced minced lamb and pine nuts, fried to a deep mahogany.

name: Chicken shawarma
notes: Spit-roasted spiced chicken, shaved off the column into a warm wrap with garlic sauce, pickles, and tomato.

name: Beef shawarma
notes: Layered, spiced beef shaved from the rotating spit and tucked into pita with tahini, pickles, and onion.

name: Manakish (za'atar)
notes: A flatbread brushed with olive oil and za'atar, baked until the herbs are fragrant and the edges blistered.

name: Kafta kebab
notes: Skewers of seasoned minced lamb with parsley and onion, charred over coals and served with tahini and pita.

name: Fatteh
notes: Toasted pita layered with chickpeas, garlicky yogurt, and a glug of warm browned butter — comfort with crunch underneath.

name: Falafel plate
notes: Crisp-shelled herbed chickpea fritters scattered over salad with tahini, hummus, pickles, and warm pita.

name: Kabab koobideh
notes: Skewers of seasoned minced lamb pressed long and thin, char-grilled and served over saffron rice with grilled tomato.

name: Ghormeh sabzi
notes: A deeply green Persian herb stew with lamb, dried lime, and red kidney beans — sour, savory, slow-cooked.

name: Fesenjan
notes: A Persian stew of chicken or duck in a glossy walnut-and-pomegranate sauce — sweet-tart, dark, and silky.

name: Saffron tahdig
notes: The prized crisp golden crust at the bottom of a pot of saffron rice — buttery, crackling, fought over.

name: Ash reshteh
notes: A thick Persian noodle soup with herbs, beans, and lentils, finished with kashk, fried mint, and crispy onion.

name: Adana kebab
notes: Minced lamb seasoned with red pepper, pressed onto wide skewers and grilled over charcoal — smoky and bold.

name: Döner kebab
notes: Layered seasoned meat roasted on a vertical spit, shaved into pita or a wrap with salad, pickles, and garlic sauce.

name: İskender kebab
notes: Sliced döner meat fanned over torn pide bread, blanketed in tomato sauce and a final pour of foaming butter and yogurt.

name: Dolma (stuffed grape leaves)
notes: Tender grape leaves rolled tight around a lemony rice-and-herb filling, served chilled with a wedge of lemon.

name: Cheese börek
notes: Coils of buttery, paper-thin phyllo wrapped around a salty cheese filling, baked until the crust crackles.

name: Lahmacun
notes: A crisp, thin Turkish flatbread spread with minced lamb, onion, and pepper, rolled with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Künefe
notes: Shredded phyllo layered over melting cheese, baked golden, soaked in rose-scented syrup, and topped with crushed pistachio.

name: Chicken tagine (preserved lemon)
notes: Chicken slow-braised in a clay pot with olives, preserved lemon, and saffron — bright, briny, and tender.

name: Lamb tagine (prune & almond)
notes: Lamb stewed slowly with prunes, almonds, cinnamon, and honey until the meat falls apart and the sauce turns deeply sweet.

name: Moroccan couscous
notes: Steamed semolina mounded high under a stew of slow-cooked lamb and seven vegetables in a fragrant broth.

name: Harira
notes: A tomato-based Moroccan soup thick with lentils, chickpeas, lamb, and herbs — traditionally eaten to break a fast.

name: Ful medames
notes: Slow-stewed fava beans mashed with olive oil, lemon, cumin, and garlic, scooped with warm flatbread.

name: Koshari
notes: An Egyptian street pile of rice, lentils, macaroni, and chickpeas crowned with crispy onions and a tangy tomato sauce.

name: Brik
notes: A paper-thin Tunisian phyllo turnover folded over tuna, parsley, and a runny egg, fried until shatter-crisp.

name: Shakshuka
notes: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato-and-pepper sauce in a sizzling skillet, scooped with bread and finished with crumbled feta.

name: B'stilla
notes: A Moroccan layered phyllo pie of shredded chicken or pigeon, almonds, and cinnamon, dusted with powdered sugar — sweet meets savory.

name: Mloukhia
notes: A glossy, almost-thick green stew of finely chopped jute leaves with meat or chicken, ladled over rice or eaten with bread.

name: Turkish meze plate
notes: A spread of small Turkish plates: yogurt-cucumber cacık, smoky eggplant, stuffed peppers, white cheese, and warm pide.

name: Jollof rice
notes: Long-grain rice cooked deep red in a tomato-pepper-onion sauce, smoky from the bottom of the pot — West Africa's most-debated dish.

name: Egusi soup
notes: A thick Nigerian stew of ground melon seed, palm oil, leafy greens, and meat — eaten with a ball of fufu or pounded yam.

name: Suya skewers
notes: Thin-sliced beef rubbed with a peanut-and-chili spice blend and grilled over charcoal, served with raw onion and tomato.

name: Fufu and palm-nut stew
notes: A smooth, stretchy starch ball torn by hand and dipped into a rich palm-nut or groundnut stew with goat or fish.

name: West African peanut stew
notes: A West African stew of chicken or beef simmered in a thick peanut-tomato sauce, served over rice with greens.

name: Waakye
notes: Ghanaian rice and beans cooked with sorghum leaves into a russet base, served with stew, fried plantain, gari, and shito.

name: Thieboudienne
notes: Senegal's national plate: spiced fish over jollof-style red rice with cabbage, eggplant, cassava, and a slick of lime.

name: Injera with doro wat
notes: Tangy spongy injera torn and dipped into doro wat — chicken and hard-boiled egg in a deep berbere stew.

name: Injera with misir wat
notes: Red split lentils simmered with berbere into a glossy stew, scooped with torn rounds of sour injera.

name: Injera with alicha
notes: A mild yellow Ethiopian stew of vegetables or chicken seasoned with turmeric and ginger, eaten with injera.

name: Ugali with sukuma wiki
notes: A firm cornmeal porridge pinched into bites and dipped into sukuma wiki — sautéed greens with onion and tomato.

name: East African pilau
notes: Long-grain rice cooked in a spiced broth with cardamom, clove, and cinnamon, threaded with tender beef and onion.

name: Bobotie
notes: A South African baked dish of curried minced beef sweetened with raisin, topped with an egg-milk custard.

name: Bunny chow
notes: A hollowed half-loaf of bread filled with a fragrant Durban-style curry — eat from the inside out with your hands.

name: Pap and chakalaka
notes: A firm white maize porridge served with chakalaka — a spicy relish of beans, carrot, pepper, and tomato.

name: Biltong plate
notes: Strips of dried, spiced South African beef sliced thin and served with cubes of cheese and crisp crackers.

name: Tacos al pastor
notes: Marinated pork shaved from a vertical spit onto small charred corn tortillas, finished with pineapple, onion, and cilantro.

name: Tacos carnitas
notes: Slow-braised, crisped-edge pork piled into warm corn tortillas with diced onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Baja fish tacos
notes: Beer-battered or grilled white fish in a soft corn tortilla with shredded cabbage, lime crema, and a hit of hot sauce.

name: Tacos de lengua
notes: Slow-braised, tender beef tongue, diced fine, served on small corn tortillas with onion, cilantro, and salsa verde.

name: Tacos de barbacoa
notes: Slow-steamed beef or lamb pulled into juicy strands, tucked into warm corn tortillas with chopped onion and cilantro.

name: Enchiladas rojas
notes: Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken, smothered in a dark red chile sauce, melted cheese, and crema.

name: Mole poblano with chicken
notes: Chicken bathed in mole poblano — a deep, glossy sauce of dried chiles, nuts, seeds, spices, and a hint of chocolate.

name: Tamales
notes: Steamed corn-husk packets of soft masa hiding a savory pork, chicken, or rajas filling — unwrap and eat warm.

name: Chilaquiles
notes: Crispy tortilla wedges simmered in a red or green salsa until just softened, topped with eggs, crema, queso fresco, and onion.

name: Pozole rojo
notes: A red-chile hominy stew with tender pork, garnished tableside with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, and oregano.

name: Sopes
notes: Thick masa rounds with pinched edges holding refried beans, shredded chicken, lettuce, crema, and crumbled cheese.

name: Huevos rancheros
notes: Sunny-side eggs on a lightly fried tortilla, blanketed in warm ranchero salsa, with beans and avocado on the side.

name: Feijoada
notes: A deep, slow-cooked Brazilian stew of black beans with smoked meats, served with rice, collards, and orange slices.

name: Moqueca
notes: A coconut-milk Brazilian fish stew in a clay pot, glossy with palm oil and bright with cilantro, tomato, and pepper.

name: Churrasco plate
notes: An assortment of fire-roasted meats sliced tableside — picanha, sausage, chicken hearts — served with rice, beans, and farofa.

name: Pão de queijo
notes: Chewy, cloud-light Brazilian cheese rolls, crisp outside and stretchy within — eaten warm by the handful.

name: Acarajé
notes: Black-eyed-pea fritters fried in palm oil, split open and stuffed with shrimp and a fiery vatapa paste — a Bahian street snack.

name: Vatapa
notes: A creamy Bahian stew of bread, ground peanuts, coconut milk, and shrimp, thickened until spoon-coats and tinted orange by palm oil.

name: Peruvian ceviche
notes: Diced raw fish cured briefly in lime juice with chile and red onion, served with sweet potato and toasted corn.

name: Lomo saltado
notes: Strips of beef wok-fired with onion, tomato, and aji amarillo, tossed with French fries and served over rice — Peru meets China.

name: Ají de gallina
notes: Shredded chicken in a creamy aji-amarillo-and-walnut sauce, served over potato slices with olives and a hard-boiled egg.

name: Anticuchos
notes: Skewers of marinated grilled beef heart, charred over coals and served with potato and a green aji sauce.

name: Papa a la huancaína
notes: Cool boiled potato slices blanketed in a creamy aji-amarillo-and-fresh-cheese sauce, plated with olives and egg.

name: Asado plate
notes: An Argentine fire-grilled mixed plate of beef short rib, sausage, sweetbreads, and morcilla, served with chimichurri.

name: Milanesa
notes: A breaded, hammered-thin beef cutlet fried golden and topped with lemon — sturdy, family-style Argentine comfort.

name: Empanadas argentinas
notes: Half-moon pastries pinched along the edge, baked or fried, holding spiced beef, olives, and egg.

name: Chimichurri grilled steak
notes: A thick grilled steak rested and sliced, drowned in a sharp parsley-garlic-oregano-vinegar chimichurri.

name: Jerk chicken
notes: Chicken marinated in scotch bonnet, allspice, and thyme, then slow-grilled until the skin is lacquered and smoky.

name: Ackee and saltfish
notes: Salt cod sautéed with onion, pepper, and tomato, folded gently with buttery ackee — Jamaica's national breakfast.

name: Ropa vieja
notes: Tender shredded beef slow-cooked in tomato, pepper, onion, and olives — "old clothes," served with rice and plantains.

name: Jamaican oxtail
notes: Oxtail braised long with butter beans in a deep, sticky gravy seasoned with allspice and thyme.

name: Callaloo
notes: Stewed leafy callaloo (or amaranth) cooked with onion, garlic, tomato, and a touch of pepper — eaten as a side or with bread.

name: Caribbean curry roti
notes: A soft flaky flatbread folded around a curry of goat, chicken, or vegetable with potato and chickpea.

name: Cuban sandwich
notes: Roast pork, ham, Swiss, mustard, and pickles pressed in Cuban bread until the cheese melts and the crust crackles.

name: Mofongo
notes: Mashed green plantain pounded with garlic and pork crackling, formed into a dome, often filled with shrimp or stew.

name: Arepas
notes: Crisp-shelled corn cakes split open and stuffed with cheese, shredded beef, or black beans — a Venezuelan-Colombian staple.

name: Pupusas
notes: Thick handmade cornmeal cakes stuffed with cheese, beans, or pork, griddled and served with curtido and salsa roja.

name: Gallo pinto
notes: Costa Rican rice and black beans cooked together with onion, pepper, and Lizano sauce, served at breakfast with eggs.

name: Baleadas
notes: A soft flour tortilla folded around refried beans, crumbled cheese, and crema — a portable Honduran lunch.

name: Haitian griot
notes: Citrus-marinated pork shoulder braised then fried until crackling on the outside and juicy within, served with pikliz.

name: Tostones
notes: Twice-fried green plantain rounds, smashed flat and salted — crackling outside, soft inside, eaten with garlic dipping sauce.

name: Arroz con pollo
notes: One-pot saffron-yellow rice studded with chicken, peas, peppers, and olives — a Sunday meal across Latin America.

name: Charcuterie board
notes: A board of cured meats, hard and soft cheeses, mustards, pickles, dried fruit, nuts, and crackers — built for grazing.

name: Antipasto platter
notes: An Italian spread of cured meats, marinated vegetables, olives, cheeses, and bread — served before a meal or as one.

name: Buttered popcorn
notes: Hot-air-popped kernels tossed with melted butter and salt — light, crunchy, addictive.

name: Caramel popcorn
notes: Popped kernels coated in a glossy caramel and baked until brittle, then broken into sticky-crisp clusters.

name: Chips & salsa
notes: Crisp salted tortilla chips beside a bowl of chunky, lime-bright tomato salsa.

name: Chips & guacamole
notes: Tortilla chips for scooping a green, lime-tart, chunky mash of avocado with onion, cilantro, and chile.

name: Chips & queso
notes: Tortilla chips dunked into a warm pool of melted cheese, fired up with green chile.

name: Roasted nut mix
notes: A warm mix of roasted, salted nuts — almonds, cashews, pecans — with a glossy oil sheen.

name: Trail mix
notes: A handful of nuts, dried fruit, and chocolate pieces — sweet, salty, energizing.

name: Crudité platter
notes: Cool, raw vegetables — carrot, cucumber, celery, radish — arrayed around a bowl of creamy dip.

name: Fruit platter
notes: Wedges of melon, pineapple, strawberries, and grapes, fanned in colorful arcs on a wide platter.

name: Mediterranean snack board
notes: A grazing board of hummus, olives, marinated feta, cucumber, pita, and roasted red peppers.

name: Pretzels with mustard
notes: Crunchy salted pretzels alongside a small bowl of sharp, grainy mustard for dipping.

name: Chocolate cake slice
notes: A wedge of moist chocolate cake layered with fudgy ganache and topped with curls of bittersweet chocolate.

name: Carrot cake with cream cheese frosting
notes: Moist spiced carrot cake studded with walnut and raisin, capped with a thick cream-cheese frosting.

name: New York cheesecake
notes: A tall slice of dense, tangy New York cheesecake on a buttery graham crust, with a faint vanilla aroma.

name: Strawberry cheesecake
notes: A cool slab of cheesecake topped with halved strawberries glistening in a glossy red glaze.

name: Tres leches cake
notes: A sponge soaked through with three milks, pillowy and dripping-sweet, finished with whipped cream and cinnamon.

name: Red velvet cake
notes: Crimson cocoa cake layered with tangy cream-cheese frosting — dramatic on the cut, soft in the bite.

name: Apple pie
notes: A double-crust pie of cinnamon-spiced apples beneath a flaky lattice, the filling syrupy and the crust bronzed.

name: Pumpkin pie
notes: A spiced pumpkin custard set in a flaky pie shell, topped with a soft cloud of whipped cream.

name: Pecan pie
notes: A buttery shell holding a glossy brown-sugar filling crammed with toasted pecan halves — sticky-sweet at the heart.

name: Key lime pie
notes: A tart, pale-yellow lime custard set into a buttery graham crust, topped with whipped cream and zest.

name: Ice cream sundae
notes: Scoops of vanilla ice cream drowned in hot fudge, crowned with whipped cream, peanuts, and a cherry on top.

name: Tiramisu
notes: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with sweet mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa — light, boozy, and silken.

name: Suji halwa
notes: Toasted semolina cooked in ghee with sugar, cardamom, and milk, studded with raisin and slivered almond.

name: Mochi ice cream
notes: Cold ice cream wrapped in a chewy, cool sleeve of mochi rice dough — one-bite contrast of soft and creamy.

name: Churros with chocolate
notes: Hot ridged dough fried golden, dusted in cinnamon sugar, served with a thick mug of melted dark chocolate for dipping.

name: Crème brûlée
notes: A vanilla custard set firm beneath a shattering layer of caramelized sugar — crack the top with a spoon.

name: Panna cotta
notes: A trembling chilled cream pudding unmolded onto a plate, served with a slick of berry sauce.

name: Crêpes Suzette
notes: Lacy crepes folded into a butter-orange-Grand-Marnier sauce, flamed at the table to a glaze.

name: Bread pudding
notes: Cubed stale bread soaked in a vanilla-egg custard with raisin, baked until the top is crisp and the inside spoon-soft.

name: Chocolate fondue
notes: A warm pot of melted chocolate kept gently bubbling, with fruit, marshmallow, and cake for dipping.

name: Affogato
notes: A scoop of cold vanilla gelato "drowned" by a fresh hot espresso poured over the top — Italy's two-ingredient finale.

name: Green smoothie
notes: Blended spinach or kale with banana, apple, and ice — bright green, vegetal, just-sweet, and cold.

name: Protein smoothie
notes: Banana, whey or plant protein, milk, and peanut butter blended thick and frothy — post-workout fuel.

name: Vanilla latte
notes: A double shot of espresso pulled into steamed milk with a hint of vanilla syrup, finished with a thin layer of foam.

name: Masala chai latte
notes: Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, ginger, clove, and pepper — fragrant, sweet, and warming.

name: Matcha latte
notes: Stone-ground green tea whisked into steamed milk to a vivid jade green, lightly sweetened.

name: Boba milk tea
notes: Sweet milk tea over chewy, dark tapioca pearls — sipped with a wide straw over ice.

name: Sweet lassi
notes: Whipped yogurt thinned with milk and sweetened with sugar, served cold — Punjabi summer refreshment.

name: Mango lassi
notes: Yogurt blended with sweet mango pulp and a pinch of cardamom — thick, golden, and cooling.

name: Mexican horchata
notes: A chilled rice-and-cinnamon drink sweetened with sugar — milky, fragrant, served over ice.

name: Watermelon agua fresca
notes: Watermelon blended with water, lime, and a touch of sugar — strained, chilled, and impossibly refreshing.

name: Hot chocolate
notes: Steamed milk whisked with dark chocolate, topped with whipped cream or marshmallows — winter in a mug.

name: Turkish coffee
notes: Unfiltered finely-ground coffee simmered with sugar in a small copper pot, served in a tiny cup with the grounds settling.

name: Continental breakfast
notes: A simple morning spread: croissants, butter, jam, fruit, yogurt, and coffee — light and fast.

name: Afternoon tea spread
notes: A tiered stand of finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and jam, and small cakes, beside a pot of strong black tea.

name: Brunch platter
notes: A late-morning combo plate: eggs, bacon, toast, hash browns, fresh fruit, and a glass of orange juice.

name: Kids' lunchbox
notes: A lunchbox of small pieces — a sandwich, cheese cubes, fruit slices, a few crackers, and a cookie.

name: Bistro plate
notes: A simple French bistro plate: roast chicken, salad with vinaigrette, crusty bread, and a glass of red.

name: Japanese breakfast
notes: A traditional set: grilled fish, miso soup, steamed rice, pickles, and a small bowl of natto or rolled egg.

name: Dim sum brunch
notes: A weekend table of steamer baskets — dumplings, buns, rice rolls, egg tarts — chased with hot tea.

name: South Indian breakfast
notes: Soft idli or crisp dosa with sambar and coconut chutney, alongside hot filter coffee.
